description_en: Queries all root and subordinate certificate authority (CA) certificates
description_zh: 查询所有根CA证书和子CA证书的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cas describe-ca-certificate-list --current-page 1 --show-size 20 --identifier 1ee47e24-c51b-67cc-aa6b-1f7561cf9d9a --cert-type subRoot --ca-status issue --valid-status valid --issuer-type local --resource-group-id rg-ae0000004wia --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCACertificateList

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含CA证书的数量。默认值为**20**
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the CA certificate.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328095.html to query the unique identifiers of all CA certificates
parameters.help_zh:
CA证书的唯一识别码。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328095.html查询所有CA证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The type of the CA. Valid values:

- root: root CA.

- subRoot: intermediate CA.

- externalCa: an imported external CA
parameters.help_zh:
CA的类型 。取值：

- root：根CA。
- subRoot：子CA。
- externalCa：外部导入的CA
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the CA. Valid values:

- issue: enabled.

- forbidden: disabled.

- revoke: revoked
parameters.help_zh:
当前的CA状态，取值：

- issue：启用。
- forbidden：禁用。
- revoke：已吊销
parameters.name: ca_status

parameters.help_en:
The validity status of the CA. Valid values:

- valid: The CA certificate is valid.

- notValid: The CA certificate has expired
parameters.help_zh:
CA时间状态。取值：

- valid：表示CA处于有效期内。
- notValid：表示CA已过期
parameters.name: valid_status

parameters.help_en:
The issuer of the CA. Valid values:

- local: private certificate.

- iTrusChina: a trusted CA.

- external: an imported external CA
parameters.help_zh:
签发CA的机构。取值：

- local：私有证书。
- iTrusChina： 合规CA。
- external：外部导入
parameters.name: issuer_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id
